entries.def: is used for the person who does an activity
entries.example: e.g. writer, painter, worker, shopper, teacher.

entries.def: are also used for things which do a particular job
can contrast with each other meaning 'person who does something' (-er) and 'person who receives or experiences the action' (-ee)
entries.example: employer/employee /emplɔi'iː/, sender/addressee, payee (e.g. of a cheque).

entries.def: are used to form nouns from verbs
entries.example: complication pollution reduction alteration donation promotion admission

entries.def: [a person] and -ism [an activity or ideology]: used for people's politics, beliefs and ideologies, and sometimes their profession (compare with -er/-or professions above)
entries.example: e.g. Buddhism, journalism, Marxist, typist, physicist, terrorist.

entries.def: is also often used for people who play musical instruments
is used to make nouns from adjectives
entries.example: goodness, readiness, forgetfulness, happiness, sadness, weakness.
drinkable washable readable forgivable edible [can be eaten] flexible [can be bent]
